_comment: Store structure as code – the launch pack sitemap. scripts/setup-store.ts creates every collection (even before products exist) as a MANUAL collection: staff tick the sub-category on the product page and the 'Tidy categories' step adds the product to its main category automatically. 'Under £5' is automated (price below £5). 'tag' is the CSV tag the bulk importer uses to put a product into that collection. Descriptions are draft copy [FOR APPROVAL].
